# local-llm-mcp

Unified MCP server for local (Ollama, LM Studio) and cloud LLM providers with 28 gateway providers, SOTA portmanteau tools, and a web dashboard.

> Full reference: [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt)

## Key Capabilities
- **Provider hardening**: Unified health service with circuit breaker, 3s timeout, Docker port conflict detection
- **Local providers**: Ollama (11434), LM Studio (1234) — connection retry with backoff, structured error types
- **28 gateway providers**: Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Groq, Claude, xAI, Mistral, OpenRouter, etc.
- **Health endpoints**: `GET /api/v1/health`, `GET /api/v1/diagnostics`, `GET /v1/gateway/providers/health`
- **Portmanteau MCP tools**: `llm_health`, `llm_models`, `llm_generation`, `llm_multimodal`, `llm_finetuning`
- **Web dashboard**: Vite/React on 10832, FastAPI backend on 10833

## Quick Start
```bash
just
# or manual: uv sync && uv run llm-mcp
```

## Ports
| Port | Service |
|------|---------|
| 10832 | Dashboard frontend (Vite) |
| 10833 | Dashboard API (FastAPI) |
| 11434 | Ollama (external dep) |
| 1234 | LM Studio (external dep) |
